original.description: Full-length portrait postcard of Wilhelm II in full dress with the eagle-crested parade helmet of the Garde du Corps, sash, stars and neck orders, resting both hands on a drawn sword. The print carries the studio imprint 'Originalaufnahme der Hofphotos. Reichard & Lindner, Berlin 1905' and 'Verlag von Gustav Liersch & Co, Berlin'.
original.archive: Deutsches Historisches Museum (LeMO), object 95007746 — via Wikimedia Commons; issued as a postcard by Gustav Liersch & Co, Berlin

colorization.author: n/a
colorization.status: not colorized — this is the monochrome archive original, reproduced as published

caption: Wilhelm II in full dress in 1905, photographed by the court photographers Reichard & Lindner and sold as a postcard — the Kaiser as he wished to be seen. Monochrome archive original.
credit: Original photograph: Reichard & Lindner, Berlin, 1905; published by Gustav Liersch & Co; Deutsches Historisches Museum via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Provided by Dave 2026-08-23 alongside two colorizations, described as 'color', but this file is the unmodified Commons original: monochrome, 284 × 747. It sits below the pipeline's smallest derivative width (320 px), so it generates no WebP variants, and it is too small to carry a Person card or a hero image. Filed as the archive original; a colorized and higher-resolution version is wanted before it is placed — sand-y0u.14.
